question: At which of the following places did Lord Buddha attain enlightenment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bodh Gaya**__.

__
 
• **At Bodh Gaya Lord Buddha attained enlightenment**__.​

 __
 
• Nirvana is a Sanskrit word that means enlightenment.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Buddhism:**

 
 
• Buddhists believe in the wisdom that once a state is attained, a person can escape the cycle of suffering and rebirth (human life).
 
• The first person to reach this state of knowledge was Siddhartha Gautama.
 
 
• Buddha was born as Prince Siddhartha at **Lumbini **near Kapilavastu (in present Nepal).
 
• He left his home at the age of 29 to become an ascetic. This event is called Mahabhishkramana.
 
• At the age of 35, Buddha attained enlightenment at Uruvela while meditating under a peepal tree on the banks of the Niranjana River. This tree came to be known as **'Bodhi Tree' and this place became Bodh Gaya (in Bihar)**.
 
• He gave his first sermon at **Sarnath **near Varanasi. This event is called Dharmachakra Pravartana.
 
• He died in 483 BC under a Sal tree in **Kushinagar **(in UP)
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• ** Four Nobel truths of Buddhism**

 
 
• Suffering (Dukha)
 
• Origin of Suffering (Samudaya)
 
• Cessation of Suffering (Nirodha)
 
• Path to the Cessation of Suffering (Magga).
 
 
 
• **Hinayana and Mahayana **are the two main groups of Buddhism.
 
 
• Hinayana emphasizes a monastic lifestyle.
 
• Mahayana Buddhism considers Buddha as God.
